confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Vietnamese tourist-town pricing, not from live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; cocktail and wine are less certain and are set from the local beer relationship (tourist bars and restaurants are typically a few times the price of a local draft). Accommodation anchors are the least certain, since Ninh Binh has fewer benchmark points than Hanoi, Hoi An or Hue and rates vary by season and location within the area. July is in the domestic and summer peak, so rates are not discounted. FX provenance: the 0.6955 value comes from search-result text citing the RBA exchange-rates page for the 15 October 2026 4pm observation; the RBA page itself was not opened directly in this session, and a third-party site showed 0.6947 for 16 October, which was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored on Hanoi-area and secondary Vietnamese tourist-town price levels (for example Hue and Hoi An), adjusted for Ninh Binh's day-trip and homestay-heavy market. Local draft beer and cafe prices are used as the base for the beer and coffee anchors.
